description: Search the Bookatu developer docs: every REST endpoint, the webhooks and their events, the MCP servers and their tools, and the guides (authentication, CORS, rate limits). Returns the parts that match, closest first, with a short snippet, their place on /developers and the markdown copy.

limit.description: Optional. How many results, 1 to 10. Default 5.

query.description: What you are looking for, e.g. "verify a webhook signature" or "POST /api/v1/{slug}/appointments".

name: search_developer_docs
